_: Design tokens — the single source for both surfaces. Edit here, run `npm run sync` at the repo root, and the website's CSS custom properties and the app's theme are both rewritten. See shared/README.md.
_contrast: Every colour here has been checked for WCAG AA against the ground it sits on. ink3 and leafDark are corrected values, not the originals. leafXl exists because leafLight only reaches 3.4:1 on the dark panels, which is fine for large display type and not for anything a customer has to read. Do not lighten any of them without re-checking.

paper.note: the ground the whole brand sits on

logo.note: the ink of the logo artwork itself, sampled from the supplied file — close to forest2 but not it, and the mark should match its own file

_type: Family NAMES are shared; the sizes are not, because a phone held at arm's length and a desktop page do not want the same scale. The website loads Vollkorn and Onest as webfonts and the app bundles Cormorant and Onest as files — verify any replacement covers `ə Ə ş Ş ğ Ğ ı İ ç Ç ö Ö ü Ü` and Cyrillic before adopting it, or an Azerbaijani schwa drops to a per-glyph fallback.

wordmark.note: the brand's own name and nothing else — Fraunces has no Cyrillic, so it must never carry translated text
